programmes.d: Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.

Sixteen-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

Tiara is a social media influencer who goes viral after posting a video of a fallout between her and a man she was dating. In an attempt to keep up her social media momentum, Tiara accepts an invitation to be flown out to meet a man named Josiah.

After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

Diagnosed with breast cancer, Rasheada fights to keep an upbeat facade for friends and family. Her sister Tara and her best friend Bunny struggle with their own demons, while trying to support Rasheada.

Sierra struggles to balance her dreams with the reality of a stable life with her devoted husband, Marcus. When an enigmatic art collector offers her the attention she's always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines.
